m.aarti.tek: Listen, beloved Bhairava: with folded hands I make my prayer. I need your grace; let me meditate on you alone.
m.aarti.pad1: I touch your feet; please hear my plea. I am dull of mind; do give me some help. Your glory is vast; let me describe a little of it.
m.aarti.pad2: You ride a dog; your rule runs in all four directions. Of all the ghosts and spirits there are, you alone are the crowned head. The weapons that are yours — how can I describe them?
m.aarti.pad3: Before the Mother you always dance as well; singing again and again in praise of her virtues, you always please her. You have a chain — how can I praise it?
m.aarti.pad4: Your glory is great; Mehandipur is renowned. Pilgrims of the world come there; it is the abode of Bajaraṅga (Hanumān). At the feet of Śrī Pretarāja Sarkāra let me lay my head.
m.aarti.pad5: Night and day may the Mother be pleased with your play, and placing her hand on your head, may she keep blessing you. With folded hands let me make my prayer, and lay my head at your feet.
